observations.summary: Main shutoff is often outside or just inside the property in line with the water meter, or in a garage, basement or closet; gate valves close clockwise until they stop; ball valves are off at a right angle to the pipe.
observations.inference_limit: San Francisco utility guidance used as general homeowner guidance, not a Santa Cruz County rule.

observations.summary: No universal rule; most experts recommend replacing washing machine hoses every three to five years or sooner; signs: bulges in rubber hoses, frayed braided hoses, kinks, leaks.

Set water heater to 120F, considered safe for most of the population; drain a quart from the tank every 3 months to remove sediment following manufacturer directions; insulate hot water pipes; most storage water heaters last 10 to 15 years, tankless more than 20.

Average household leaks can waste more than 9,300 gallons a year; nine percent of homes waste 50 gallons or more per day; meter test over two hours of no use; food coloring toilet test within 10 minutes; replace flappers at least every five years.

Inspect at least every three years, systems with pumps or mechanical parts generally once a year; tanks typically pumped every three to five years depending on household size, wastewater, solids and tank size; keep records; spread laundry; fix running toilets; keep roof drains and sump water away from the drainfield.
observations.inference_limit: National homeowner guidance; not a local code requirement.
